ayahOccurrences.text: أَفَحَسِبْتُمْ أَنَّمَا خَلَقْنَٰكُمْ عَبَثًا وَأَنَّكُمْ إِلَيْنَا لَا تُرْجَعُونَ
ayahOccurrences.highlightedHtml: أَفَحَسِبْتُمْ أَنَّمَا خَلَقْنَٰكُمْ عَبَثًا وَأَنَّكُمْ إِلَيْنَا لَا تُرْجَعُونَ

lexSnapshot.derivativeNote: عَبَثًا is in the derivative form: عَبَثٌ
lexSnapshot.rootDefinitionHtml:
ع/ب/ث   ʿ–b–th a mix up of things, adulteration, folly, to waste time in useless activity; to commit a folly.

Of this root, 2 forms occur 1 time each in the Qur’an:
تَعْبَثُون taʿbathūn and عَبَثاً ʿabathan.
lexSnapshot.mainDefinitionHtml:
عَبَثٌ ʿabath [v. n.] jest, frivolity, vain activity, absence of reason, lack of purpose

(23:115) أَفَحَسِبْتُمْ‏ ‏أَنَّمَا‏ ‏خَلَقْنَاكُمْ عَبَثًا did you think We created you in vain?

entries.label: تَعْبَثُ
entries.definitionHtml:
تَعْبَثُ taʿbath [imperf. v., intrans.] to act frivolously, to play around, to act in jest, to act in vanity

(26:128) أَتَبْنُونَ‏ ‏بِكُلِّ‏ ‏رِيعٍ‏ ‏ءَايَةً‏ ‏تَعْبَثُونَ do you set up monuments [also: altars, road signs or gathering places] on every height to satisfy your vanity? [also: jesting?]
